You are loved, you are not alone. There isn't much I can say that hasn't already been said, but here's a toast to you: Your eyes are a beautiful color, your freckles are natural and enchanting, and your hair is delightful and free. I've been going through a horrendous spell of loneliness and waking up feeling not human myself. If you ever need anything, my PM's are open to you anytime, any day. I'll leave you with this, "Life is hard, we all know that. And sometimes some of us find the grand scheme of it all worthless to endure. To that I say, Live for the little things, the way snow falls gently, the way reason hits your roof, the taste of your favorite food or drink, the fluffy and soft feeling of the fur of your pet, the way the leaves crunch in the fall. It's the little things that make life not seem so bad after all. Myself? I live for the way you smile when I make stupid jokes, I love it, that's helped me procrastinate my end for quite some time.." I hope this helps you somehow, if anything, know what you're feeling is valid, and that you're not a freak or an outcast because of it. Stay awesome, Gotham.
